text: {"name":"ke_send_rf_calibration_msg","confidence":"medium","docstring":"Sends the 0x6A PDU, resolves crystal-cap trims from efuse or user overrides, and applies the associated RF calibration values.","subsystem":"ke","var_renames":{"a2":"rf_calibration_config","v6":"xtal_cap","v7":"xtal_cap_fine","v8":"xtal_cap_coarse"},"struct_hints":[{"offset":0,"meaning":"RF calibration value written for the 2.4-GHz channel"},{"offset":4,"meaning":"RF calibration value written for 5-GHz channels"},{"offset":8,"meaning":"Additional RF value paired with offset 0 for the 2.4-GHz channel"},{"offset":12,"meaning":"Nonzero value triggers the interrupt dispatcher"},{"offset":20,"meaning":"Optional user override for coarse crystal capacitance"},{"offset":21,"meaning":"Optional user override for fine crystal capacitance"}]}
